_comment: Self-clean rule registry. Every rule lands in 'announce' mode (report-only, no moves). Promotion to 'quarantine' per-rule after >=3 sweeps with zero false positives (LR-069 §3.3). Hard-delete only at quarantine-TTL expiry (30d) for regenerable items.
_never_sweep_note: Hard floor checked before any rule. Items here are NEVER touched regardless of rule match. Includes: owner-ruled retained dirs (website/), auth/env state, shipped client surface, LR-042 chain-state, live runtime state, quarantine dir itself, and owner-protected backups.
